name: conductor
description: Install, inspect, plan, run, validate, and update Factory workflows without weakening Factory Core gates.

interface.longDescription: Factory provides guarded setup, diagnosis, progress, continuation, validation, and update workflows for repositories using Factory Core.
interface.defaultPrompt: Inspect this repository with Factory and tell me the next legal action.

skills.description: Diagnose the Factory installation, environment, project compatibility, blockers, and next legal action without changing the repository.
Prepare a preview-only Factory setup plan for a new repository, preserving human authorization and repository safety gates.
Prepare a preview-only Factory adoption plan for an existing repository, preserving user-owned files and halting on conflicts.
Report Factory run state, completed validators, blockers, and the next legal action from deterministic disk evidence.
Continue a Factory run through the next legal action at G1 Intent Lock, G2 Governed Execution, or G3 Review and Completion, stopping at every human countersign.
Run the applicable deterministic Factory validators and report evidence-backed pass or halt results.
Preview Factory compatibility and update changes, requiring explicit approval before any repository mutation.
